body.statement: For continuous conditioning, GANICE Theorems 2 and 3 give upper and lower minimax results that are matched only up to logarithmic and implementation-transfer factors under its statewise causal risk.

source.locator: Theorems 2--3 and the sentence immediately following Theorem 3, arXiv:2605.10206v1, Section 5
source.verbatim_statement: Theorems 2--3 give minimax optimality, up to logarithmic and implementation-transfer factors, under the statewise causal risk \(\mathrm{eW}_{1}\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from Tamano and Imaizumi, arXiv:2605.10206v1, Section 5, sentence immediately following Theorem 3.
